hints.title: Closed-Form Contribution
hints.text: Calculate the total tickets purchased by each person before person k finishes purchasing.

hints.title: Position Parity
hints.text: People positioned before k buy at most tickets at index k, while people after k buy at most one less.

hints.title: Direct Accumulation
hints.text: Sum the bounded ticket counts across all positions in a single iteration.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(N) single pass through tickets array
variables: N: number of people in ticket line
complexity.notes: People before k buy at most tickets[k] tickets while people after k buy at most tickets[k] - 1.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating round-by-round decrement takes O(N * max(tickets)) which is slow for large values.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Closed-form summation calculates the exact rounds in linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should compute min(tickets[i], tickets[k] - (i > k)).
